2 Chemical Giants Cut Their Dividends. This Third Stock Kept Raising
summary: Overcapacity, Middle East turmoil, and shaky margins have forced some chemical makers to shrink the checks they send shareholders. Retirees chasing yield in this sector face one question: whose payout is built on cash flow, and whose still carries risk?
